maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new banknote supply to central banks, new security features and new payment/validation equipment; aftermarket services are the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Crane Currency sells banknotes to central banks, but payment equipment and authentication sales to private businesses and brands make up much of revenue.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own technology and product sales; acquisitions such as Antares Vision and Crane Currency are occasional large deals.

mission_critical.reason: Banknote security features and payment validators are qualified into customers' currencies and machines; switching needs re-qualification and risks disruption.

notes: Revenue mix between central-bank banknote sales and private-sector payment equipment is uncertain, so the publicly funded answer is a judgment call.
